title: GithubReport
description: An OFFLINE-first ingestion report over a LOCAL repo fixture (a directory tree, or a {path: content} JSON), the intake front-end of the Primitive Discovery Factory. One row per (repo, report_type): it stores paths, languages, digests, and extracted STRUCTURED UNITS + bounded, secret-redacted snippets — NEVER raw file bodies — and proposes candidate primitives / verifiers / benchmarks mined from those units. candidate; serves_truth=false. Generation is not promotion.

report_id.description: canonical_id('ghreport', repo, report_type, commit_sha) — '{prefix}-{sha256[:16]}'. Never a name-embedded version.

repo.description: repo label, e.g. 'OWNER/REPO' (live) or the local fixture basename (offline).

commit_sha.description: The git commit sha for --live; for an offline fixture a deterministic content anchor 'tree:<sha256[:16]>' over the sorted (path, file-digest) pairs, so report_id is content-addressed and reproducible.

report_type.description: Which lens produced this report. repo_inventory | primitive_mining | test_fixture are the implemented lenses; ci | security | pr_issue | dependency are reserved forward-compat seams (add a builder row to implement one).

schema_version.description: Schema version metadata — version lives HERE, never in an id or name.

source_refs.description: Provenance handles the findings were derived from — file paths + digests, spec files, the tree anchor. Handles + digests only; never a raw body.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from an INJECTED clock (no wall-clock in tests).

findings.description: What the lens observed (language distribution, manifests, entrypoints, detected units, 'N tests imply a reusable primitive', …). Structured detail, no raw bodies.

candidate_primitives.description: Reusable-component candidates mined from the units (small pure functions, pydantic models, api endpoints/specs, test-backed primitives). Born candidate=true, serves_truth=false.

signature.description: Secret-redacted signature/binding; never a raw body.

candidate_verifiers.description: Proof obligations that would promote a candidate (unit/property test, schema roundtrip, contract test, golden case table). candidate=true.

candidate_benchmarks.description: Measurable hooks (reuse-vs-regenerate token savings, golden regression suites) a promotion gate would run. candidate=true.

risk_flags.description: Ingestion risks (secret-shaped strings redacted, license-review, injection/jailbreak signal, unresolved source) that gate promotion.

artifact_refs.description: Pointers to salient artifacts the report references (manifests, entrypoints, spec files, staged output). Pointers only.

secrets_redacted.description: Count of secret-shaped substrings scrubbed before this row was written.
